name: sciehub
description: SCIEHub - a GitHub-style materials sharing platform for SCIErs

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @sciehub/server" "npm run dev -w @sciehub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sciehub/shared && npm run build -w @sciehub/server && npm run build -w @sciehub/web
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run start -w @sciehub/server
